title: Hardship Settlement Signing Window After Earlier Offers Expired Unaccepted
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Lapsed-Offer Shortening of the Signing Window

Settlement offers on an account that reached their expiry date without acceptance show in Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements records in status expired.

**Rule.** When a consumer accepts a Hardship Settlement offer by electronic signature, where two or more settlement offers on the account dated after the same calendar day twelve months before the acceptance date have expired unaccepted, the Hardship Settlement signing window is shortened by 6 days for lapsed offers; where exactly one such offer has expired, by 3 days; an account with no such expired offer takes no lapsed-offer shortening of the signing window.

## Counting the lapsed offers

- Offers on the same account, of any programme, whose offer date is after the same calendar day twelve months before the acceptance date.
- Only offers in status expired count; an offer withdrawn, accepted, defaulted or fulfilled does not.

| Expired offers counted | Shortening |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 6 days |
| exactly 1 | 3 days |
| none | none |

## Hypothetical case

An account shows one Lump-Sum offer that expired four months before the signing and one Two-Payment offer that expired thirteen months before, the latter dated more than twelve months back: one expired offer counts, so the window is shortened by 3 days.
